basics.name: Aryan Lenka
basics.label: M.Tech Student, Production & Industrial Engineering
basics.summary: M.Tech student in Production and Industrial Engineering at NIT Kurukshetra, with research experience in CFD, hydrogen energy systems, and combustion engineering. Interested in manufacturing systems and process optimization.

work.name: CSIR-CMERI (Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute)
highlights: Conducted numerical investigation of hydrogen-ammonia blended combustion at varying mixing ratios using CONVERGE CFD, under guidance of Sr. Principal Scientist Mr. Subho Samanta.
Studied the effects of flow dynamics and alveolar mechanics in the acinar region of human lungs using computational modeling.
Contributed to research leading to lab set-up and modified test rigs in LPG Lab.

work.name: ZOE Energy Solutions
highlights: Market research and product development of Solar Batteries.

work.name: CTTC (Central Tool Room & Training Centre)
highlights: Learned to develop a full stack web application utilizing Django framework, implementing core Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) design principles.
Implemented relational database management architectures and designed GUI interfaces for custom software modules.

work.name: Collins Aerospace
highlights: Worked on S1000D standards for Component Maintenance Manuals in the Power & Controls department.
Gained hands-on proficiency with Siemens NX and ARBORTEXT ISODRAW for technical documentation.

work.name: CTTC (Central Tool Room & Training Centre)
highlights: Trained on manufacturing procedures for hand injection moulds, including Cavity Plate, Core Plate, Core Pin, and Dowel Pin fabrication.
Gained practical experience with CATIA V5 for part design and assembly.

work.name: Tata Lockheed Martin Aerostructures Ltd.
highlights: Gained firsthand exposure to aerospace manufacturing, focusing on Empennage fabrication processes.
Studied engineering drawing standards and precision manufacturing methods used in defense aviation.

volunteer.summary: Managed outgoing global talent programs and international exchange initiatives.
Contributed to student-led automotive engineering projects and competitions.

awards.title: Best Paper Award, ICRAMERD 2024
awards.summary: Awarded for the conference paper 'Optimization of Bezier Curve Using Genetic Algorithm for the Design of a Bell-Shape Nozzle Contour.'

publications.name: Optimization of Bezier Curve Using Genetic Algorithm for the Design of a Bell-Shape Nozzle Contour
publications.summary: Applied evolutionary optimization to aerodynamic nozzle design. Accepted and won Best Paper Award.

projects.name: Modelling & Analysis of Embedded Cooling Tube Reactor for Low-Energy Hydrogen Storage in Solid State
projects.summary: Investigated metal hydride-based storage techniques and various reactor geometries for improved thermal management.

projects.name: 4-DOF Robotic Arm Assembly
projects.summary: Designed and programmed a robotic manipulator using Arduino UNO, implementing kinematic control via Arduino IDE.

projects.name: Health Monitoring System (ESP32)
projects.summary: Developed a real-time IoT device for blood oxygen level and body temperature monitoring.

projects.name: Cup Sealing Machine
projects.summary: Designed and assembled a manual press cup sealing machine, applying manufacturing and fabrication principles.

projects.name: Jigs & Fixtures Design
projects.summary: Studied and prototyped industrial jigs and fixtures; gained insight into precision tooling for production environments.

projects.name: Dual DC Regulated Power Supply
projects.summary: Designed a variable DC power supply circuit for laboratory applications.
